perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: The 3,199-mile autonomy-equipped J208 flight broadens optionality into freight, emergency response and defense logistics.
Vertiport and Toyota manufacturing partnerships make infrastructure and industrialization explicit commercialization mechanisms.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: FAA-conforming TIA aircraft flight and conforming-parts production are concrete progress, but type certification remains incomplete.
Toyota production-system transfer is a credible scale mechanism while certification, production-rate and vertiport readiness remain critical dependencies.

risks: autonomy demonstration not equivalent to approval/revenue
unknowns: unit economics and achieved production rate
near-term financial effect of autonomy programs
